name: Bitstream Voxel Position Encoding
definition: A method to encode the 3D position of a voxel into a linear bitstream for tree traversal, where each child index is determined by 3 bits.
summary: Bitstream Voxel Position Encoding maps 3D voxel coordinates to a linear bitstream for deterministic Octree traversal, using 3 bits per coordinate level to guide navigation from root to leaf.
